text: 永和九年，岁在癸丑，暮春之初，会于会稽山阴之兰亭，修禊事也
pinyin: yǒng hé jiǔ nián, suì zài guǐ chǒu, mù chūn zhī chū, huì yú kuài jī shān yīn zhī lán tíng, xiū xì shì yě
literal: Yonghe · ninth · year, year · in · Guichou, late · spring · [of] · beginning, gather · at · Kuaiji · Shanyin · [of] · Orchid Pavilion, perform · lustration · matter · [particle]
natural: In the ninth year of Yonghe, a Guichou year, at the start of late spring, we gathered at the Orchid Pavilion in Shanyin, Kuaiji, to hold the spring purification rite

meaning.en: The famous opening of the 'Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Collection', the most celebrated piece of Chinese calligraphy and prose.
meaning.zh: 《兰亭集序》的著名开头，该文与其书法同为千古名作。

equivalents: the opening of the Orchid Pavilion Preface

examples.zh: 书法课上，老师带大家临摹“永和九年，岁在癸丑，暮春之初，会于会稽山阴之兰亭，修禊事也”。
examples.en: In calligraphy class the teacher had everyone copy '永和九年，岁在癸丑，暮春之初，会于会稽山阴之兰亭，修禊事也'.

examples.zh: 纪念册扉页抄着“永和九年，岁在癸丑，暮春之初，会于会稽山阴之兰亭，修禊事也”。
examples.en: '永和九年，岁在癸丑，暮春之初，会于会稽山阴之兰亭，修禊事也' is copied on the first page of the souvenir album.

story.en: In AD 353, Wang Xizhi and about forty friends gathered at the Orchid Pavilion near Shaoxing, composed poems while floating wine cups on a stream, and Wang wrote this preface.
story.zh: 353年三月三，王羲之与四十余位名士在绍兴兰亭修禊，曲水流觞赋诗，王羲之作此序。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 群贤毕至，少长咸集
pinyin: qún xián bì zhì, shào zhǎng xián jí
literal: assembled · worthies · all · arrive, young · old · all · gather
natural: All the worthy have arrived; young and old are gathered together

meaning.en: A gathering of distinguished people of all ages; quoted to describe a grand, lively assembly.
meaning.zh: 贤士毕至，老少齐聚，形容盛大热闹的聚会。

equivalents: a distinguished gathering of all ages

examples.zh: 论坛开幕，“群贤毕至，少长咸集”，场面热烈。
examples.en: The forum opened with '群贤毕至，少长咸集', and the atmosphere was lively.

examples.zh: 婚礼现场“群贤毕至，少长咸集”，欢声笑语。
examples.en: At the wedding '群贤毕至，少长咸集', all was laughter.

story.en: From the Orchid Pavilion Preface, describing the guests who joined the gathering of AD 353.
story.zh: 出自《兰亭集序》，写353年兰亭雅集宾客齐至。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 山水之乐，得之心而寓之酒也
pinyin: shān shuǐ zhī lè, dé zhī xīn ér yù zhī jiǔ yě
literal: mountain · water · [of] · joy, get · it · in heart · and · lodge · it · in · wine · [particle]
natural: The joy of mountains and waters is grasped in the heart and lodged in wine

meaning.en: True enjoyment of nature is inward, merely expressed through wine; quoted to say the pleasure lies in the spirit, not the drink or the place.
meaning.zh: 领会山水之乐在于内心，借酒表达，常用来说明乐趣在于心境而非外物。

equivalents: the joy of nature is in the heart

examples.zh: “山水之乐，得之心而寓之酒也”，他爱的是山水，不是酒。
examples.en: '山水之乐，得之心而寓之酒也': what he loves is the landscape, not the wine.

examples.zh: 游记里作者引用“山水之乐，得之心而寓之酒也”抒怀。
examples.en: In the travel essay the author quoted '山水之乐，得之心而寓之酒也' to express his feelings.

story.en: From Ouyang Xiu's essay 'The Old Drunkard's Pavilion' (1046), written while he was demoted to Chuzhou.
story.zh: 1046年欧阳修贬官滁州时所作《醉翁亭记》。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 无他，但手熟尔
pinyin: wú tā, dàn shǒu shú ěr
literal: no · other, only · hand · practised · [particle]
natural: It's nothing special, I'm just practised at it

meaning.en: Skill comes from practice, not magic; quoted to say that mastery is simply long repetition.
meaning.zh: 本领没有别的诀窍，只是熟能生巧，常用来说明技艺来自反复练习。

equivalents: it's just a matter of practice

examples.zh: 他说“无他，但手熟尔”，其实练了二十年。
examples.en: He said '无他，但手熟尔', but he had practised for twenty years.

examples.zh: 面对赞美，老师傅只说一句“无他，但手熟尔”。
examples.en: Faced with praise, the old master said only '无他，但手熟尔'.

story.en: In the story, an oil seller watches an archer boast and calmly pours oil through a coin's hole without spilling, saying this.
story.zh: 故事中卖油翁见康肃公射箭自夸，以油注钱孔不沾钱，并说此语。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 人生若只如初见，何事秋风悲画扇
pinyin: rén shēng ruò zhǐ rú chū jiàn, hé shì qiū fēng bēi huà shàn
literal: life · if · only · like · first · meeting, why · autumn · wind · grieve · painted · fan
natural: If life were only like the first meeting, why would autumn winds grieve over the painted fan?

meaning.en: Relationships never feel as good as at first sight, and later disappointments abandon them like a fan in autumn; quoted about lost love and fading feeling.
meaning.zh: 人与人若永远如初见时的美好，便不会有后来的离弃与失望，常用于感叹爱情变淡。

equivalents: if only it were always like the first meeting
the sweetness of first sight fades

examples.zh: 分手后他发了一句“人生若只如初见，何事秋风悲画扇”。
examples.en: After the break-up he posted '人生若只如初见，何事秋风悲画扇'.

examples.zh: “人生若只如初见，何事秋风悲画扇”，初恋总是最难忘。
examples.en: '人生若只如初见，何事秋风悲画扇': first love is always the hardest to forget.

origin.source: 纳兰性德《木兰花·拟古决绝词柬友》

story.en: Qing poet Nalan Xingde's lyric in the voice of a spurned woman, echoing the Han poem of Consort Ban and her fan.
story.zh: 清代纳兰性德以弃妇口吻所作，化用班婕妤秋扇之典。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 一生一代一双人，争教两处销魂
pinyin: yī shēng yī dài yī shuāng rén, zhēng jiào liǎng chù xiāo hún
literal: one · life · one · generation · one · pair · people, how · make · two · places · heartbroken
natural: One life, one lifetime, one couple; how could they be made to pine apart in two places?

meaning.en: An ideal of one lifelong partner, lamenting that lovers are parted; quoted about devoted love and separation.
meaning.zh: 理想的爱情是一生一世一双人，感叹有情人却两地相思，常用于谈专一的爱与别离。

examples.zh: 婚礼请柬上印着“一生一代一双人，争教两处销魂”。
examples.en: The wedding invitation has '一生一代一双人，争教两处销魂' printed on it.

examples.zh: 他的网名取自“一生一代一双人，争教两处销魂”。
examples.en: His online name comes from '一生一代一双人，争教两处销魂'.

origin.source: 纳兰性德《画堂春·一生一代一双人》

story.en: A lyric by Nalan Xingde, often read as a tribute to his late wife, or as a lament for impossible love.
story.zh: 纳兰性德词作，一说悼念亡妻，一说抒写爱而不得之苦。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 山一程，水一程，身向榆关那畔行，夜深千帐灯
pinyin: shān yī chéng, shuǐ yī chéng, shēn xiàng yú guān nà pàn xíng, yè shēn qiān zhàng dēng
literal: mountain · one · stage, water · one · stage, body · toward · Yuguan · that · side · go, night · deep · thousand · tents · lamps
natural: One more mountain, one more river; I travel beyond Yuguan Pass, and deep at night a thousand tents glow with lamps

meaning.en: A soldier on campaign far from home among mountains and rivers; quoted for the hardship of travel and homesickness.
meaning.zh: 写随军出关、山水迢迢、思念故乡的羁旅之苦。

equivalents: mountain after mountain, river after river

examples.zh: 春运路上，他想起“山一程，水一程，身向榆关那畔行，夜深千帐灯”。
examples.en: On the Spring Festival trek home, he thought of '山一程，水一程，身向榆关那畔行，夜深千帐灯'.

examples.zh: 纪录片用“山一程，水一程，身向榆关那畔行，夜深千帐灯”作旁白。
examples.en: The documentary used '山一程，水一程，身向榆关那畔行，夜深千帐灯' as narration.

origin.source: 纳兰性德《长相思·山一程》

story.en: Nalan Xingde wrote this while accompanying the Kangxi emperor on a tour beyond Shanhaiguan (Yuguan) in 1682.
story.zh: 1682年纳兰性德随康熙帝出山海关（榆关）东巡时所作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 少年听雨歌楼上，红烛昏罗帐。壮年听雨客舟中，江阔云低、断雁叫西风
pinyin: shào nián tīng yǔ gē lóu shàng, hóng zhú hūn luó zhàng, zhuàng nián tīng yǔ kè zhōu zhōng, jiāng kuò yún dī, duàn yàn jiào xī fēng
literal: youth · listen · rain · singing · house · on, red · candle · dim · silk · bed-curtain; prime of life · listen · rain · traveller's · boat · in, river · wide · clouds · low, straggling · goose · cry · west · wind
natural: In youth I listened to the rain in a singing-house, red candles dimming the silk curtains; in my prime I listened on a traveller's boat, the river wide, clouds low, a lone goose crying in the west wind

meaning.en: Hearing the same rain at different life stages reveals how experience changes feeling; quoted for the passing of life and the weight of years.
meaning.zh: 同一场雨在人生不同阶段听来不同，常用来感叹岁月沧桑、心境变迁。

equivalents: the same rain, heard through different years

examples.zh: 读到“少年听雨歌楼上，红烛昏罗帐。壮年听雨客舟中，江阔云低、断雁叫西风”，不禁感叹时光飞逝。
examples.en: Reading '少年听雨歌楼上，红烛昏罗帐。壮年听雨客舟中，江阔云低、断雁叫西风', I couldn't help sighing at the speed of time.

examples.zh: 老教授在回忆录里引用“少年听雨歌楼上，红烛昏罗帐。壮年听雨客舟中，江阔云低、断雁叫西风”。
examples.en: The old professor quoted '少年听雨歌楼上，红烛昏罗帐。壮年听雨客舟中，江阔云低、断雁叫西风' in his memoir.

story.en: Song-Yuan poet Jiang Jie's lyric, written in old age after the fall of the Song dynasty; the closing lines (not quoted) have him listening to the rain as an old man in a monastery.
story.zh: 宋末元初蒋捷晚年所作，经历国破之后；结尾（未引）写老年在僧庐听雨。

date.en: late Song to early Yuan, late 13th c.

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 被酒莫惊春睡重，赌书消得泼茶香。当时只道是寻常
pinyin: bèi jiǔ mò jīng chūn shuì zhòng, dǔ shū xiāo dé pō chá xiāng, dāng shí zhǐ dào shì xún cháng
literal: wine-flushed · don't · disturb · spring · sleep · deep, bet · books · worth · spilled · tea · fragrance. at that time · only · thought · was · ordinary
natural: Flushed with wine, do not wake my deep spring sleep; the fragrance of spilled tea rewards our book-quoting game; at the time we thought it all quite ordinary

meaning.en: Happiness one only recognises after loss; quoted about cherishing ordinary moments of love before they are gone.
meaning.zh: 唯有失去后才懂得当初平凡的幸福，常用来说明要珍惜眼前普通的相伴时光。

equivalents: you don't know what you've got till it's gone

examples.zh: 失去后才明白“被酒莫惊春睡重，赌书消得泼茶香。当时只道是寻常”。
examples.en: Only after losing it did I understand '被酒莫惊春睡重，赌书消得泼茶香。当时只道是寻常'.

examples.zh: 朋友圈配图写着“被酒莫惊春睡重，赌书消得泼茶香。当时只道是寻常”。
examples.en: The photo caption read '被酒莫惊春睡重，赌书消得泼茶香。当时只道是寻常'.

origin.source: 纳兰性德《浣溪沙·谁念西风独自凉》

story.en: Nalan's lyric remembering his late wife, alluding to Li Qingzhao and Zhao Mingcheng's game of guessing which book a quotation came from.
story.zh: 纳兰性德悼念亡妻之作，用李清照与赵明诚赌书泼茶之典。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 夜来风雨声，花落知多少
pinyin: yè lái fēng yǔ shēng, huā luò zhī duō shǎo
literal: night · came · wind · rain · sound, flowers · fall · know · how many
natural: Last night there was the sound of wind and rain; who knows how many flowers have fallen

meaning.en: Wistful thought about the flowers lost in a spring storm; quoted for the passing of spring and the quiet sadness of fading beauty.
meaning.zh: 春夜风雨之后想到落花无数，常用来表达惜春、伤逝的淡淡愁绪。

equivalents: how many blossoms did the storm bring down?

examples.zh: 一场春雨后，朋友圈里全是“夜来风雨声，花落知多少”。
examples.en: After a spring rain, my feed was full of '夜来风雨声，花落知多少'.

examples.zh: 孩子奶声奶气地背着“夜来风雨声，花落知多少”。
examples.en: The child recited '夜来风雨声，花落知多少' in a small sweet voice.

story.en: The closing couplet of Meng Haoran's 'Spring Morning', one of the first Tang poems children learn.
story.zh: 孟浩然《春晓》的末联，是儿童最早背诵的唐诗之一。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 见贤思齐焉，见不贤而内自省也
pinyin: jiàn xián sī qí yān, jiàn bù xián ér nèi zì xǐng yě
literal: see · worthy · think · equal · [particle], see · not · worthy · and · inwardly · self · reflect · [particle]
natural: When you see a worthy person, think of matching them; when you see an unworthy one, look inward and examine yourself

meaning.en: Learn from good examples and use bad ones as a mirror; quoted as advice on self-improvement.
meaning.zh: 见到贤者就向他看齐，见到不贤者就反省自己，常用于勉励人自我提升。

equivalents: learn from the good, reflect on the bad

examples.zh: 班主任把“见贤思齐焉，见不贤而内自省也”写在黑板上。
examples.en: The class teacher wrote '见贤思齐焉，见不贤而内自省也' on the blackboard.

examples.zh: 同事做得好，我们应“见贤思齐焉，见不贤而内自省也”。
examples.en: When a colleague does well, we should follow '见贤思齐焉，见不贤而内自省也'.

story.en: Confucius in the Analects, chapter 'Li Ren', on how to treat other people as models or warnings.
story.zh: 孔子在《论语·里仁》中论如何把他人当作榜样或镜子。

usage.en: A quotation from the Analects; formal, used to make an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 《论语》引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 敏而好学，不耻下问
pinyin: mǐn ér hào xué, bù chǐ xià wèn
literal: quick · and · love · learning, not · be ashamed · below · ask
natural: Quick of mind and fond of learning, not ashamed to ask those below him

meaning.en: Be clever yet love study, and never be too proud to ask juniors; quoted to praise humble, eager learners.
meaning.zh: 聪敏又好学，并且不以向地位或学识比自己低的人请教为耻。

equivalents: eager to learn and not ashamed to ask

examples.zh: 院士一生“敏而好学，不耻下问”，深受学生爱戴。
examples.en: The academician all his life '敏而好学，不耻下问', and his students loved him.

examples.zh: “敏而好学，不耻下问”是做学问的基本态度。
examples.en: '敏而好学，不耻下问' is the basic attitude of scholarship.

story.en: Zigong asks why Kong Wenzi was given the posthumous title 'Wen' (cultured); Confucius answers with this line.
story.zh: 子贡问孔文子为何谥为“文”，孔子以此句作答。

usage.en: A quotation from the Analects; formal, used to make an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 《论语》引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 己欲立而立人，己欲达而达人
pinyin: jǐ yù lì ér lì rén, jǐ yù dá ér dá rén
literal: self · wish · to establish · and · establish · others, self · wish · to succeed · and · help succeed · others
natural: Wishing to establish yourself, help others to establish themselves; wishing to succeed, help others to succeed

meaning.en: Benevolence means helping others achieve what you want for yourself; quoted for generosity and teamwork.
meaning.zh: 仁者想自己立身成功，也帮助别人立身成功，常用来说明成人之美与互助。

equivalents: help others succeed as you wish to

examples.zh: 导师一向“己欲立而立人，己欲达而达人”，帮学生铺路。
examples.en: The mentor always '己欲立而立人，己欲达而达人', paving the way for students.

examples.zh: 企业文化提倡“己欲立而立人，己欲达而达人”。
examples.en: The company culture advocates '己欲立而立人，己欲达而达人'.

story.en: Confucius, asked by Zigong about benevolence (仁), says a person of ren helps others to achieve what he himself wants.
story.zh: 子贡问仁，孔子答仁者自己想立、想达，也帮助别人立、达。

usage.en: A quotation from the Analects; formal, used to make an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 《论语》引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 君子喻于义，小人喻于利
pinyin: jūn zǐ yù yú yì, xiǎo rén yù yú lì
literal: gentleman · understands · in terms of · righteousness, petty person · understands · in terms of · profit
natural: The gentleman understands what is right; the petty person understands what is profitable

meaning.en: A gentleman is guided by principle and a petty person by self-interest; quoted when contrasting ideals with profit-seeking.
meaning.zh: 君子以道义为重，小人以利益为先，常用来对比理想与逐利。

equivalents: gentlemen think of right, others of gain

examples.zh: 商界不乏“君子喻于义，小人喻于利”的对比。
examples.en: The business world is full of the contrast of '君子喻于义，小人喻于利'.

examples.zh: 他说“君子喻于义，小人喻于利”，所以拒绝了这笔回扣。
examples.en: He said '君子喻于义，小人喻于利', and so turned down the kickback.

story.en: Confucius in the Analects, chapter 'Li Ren', contrasting the motives of the junzi and the xiaoren.
story.zh: 孔子在《论语·里仁》中对比君子与小人的取向。

usage.en: A quotation from the Analects; formal, used to make an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 《论语》引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 老吾老，以及人之老；幼吾幼，以及人之幼
pinyin: lǎo wú lǎo, yǐ jí rén zhī lǎo, yòu wú yòu, yǐ jí rén zhī yòu
literal: respect · my · elders, extend to · others' · elders; care for · my · young, extend to · others' · young
natural: Treat my own elders as elders and extend it to others' elders; treat my own young as young and extend it to others' young

meaning.en: Extend the love for your own family to all people; quoted for compassion and community spirit.
meaning.zh: 把爱护自己长辈、孩子的心扩展到别人的长辈和孩子，常用来倡导爱心与社区互助。

equivalents: extend your love beyond your own family
treat other people's parents as your own

examples.zh: 志愿者们照顾孤寡老人，真正做到“老吾老，以及人之老；幼吾幼，以及人之幼”。
examples.en: The volunteers care for lonely old people, truly living out '老吾老，以及人之老；幼吾幼，以及人之幼'.

examples.zh: 社区墙上写着“老吾老，以及人之老；幼吾幼，以及人之幼”。
examples.en: '老吾老，以及人之老；幼吾幼，以及人之幼' is written on the community wall.

story.en: Mencius advises King Hui of Liang that a ruler who extends familial love to all his people can govern the realm as easily as turning it in his palm.
story.zh: 孟子劝梁惠王推己及人，便可治天下如运于掌。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻
pinyin: mín wéi guì, shè jì cì zhī, jūn wéi qīng
literal: people · are · most precious, altars of state · next · it, ruler · is · light
natural: The people are the most important; the state comes second; the ruler is the least

meaning.en: A classic statement that the people matter more than the ruler; quoted in discussions of government and public service.
meaning.zh: 民比国家和君主更重要，是古代民本思想的名言，常用于谈政府与为民服务。

examples.zh: 市长在讲话中引用“民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻”。
examples.en: The mayor quoted '民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻' in his speech.

examples.zh: “民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻”体现了古代的民本思想。
examples.en: '民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻' shows the ancient idea of people-centredness.

story.en: Mencius, in the chapter 'Jinxin II', puts the people first, then the state altars, and the ruler last.
story.zh: 孟子《尽心下》中将民、社稷、君的轻重排序。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

synonyms: 天下之治乱，不在一姓之兴亡，而在万民之忧乐

text: 天将降大任于是人也，必先苦其心志，劳其筋骨
pinyin: tiān jiāng jiàng dà rèn yú shì rén yě, bì xiān kǔ qí xīn zhì, láo qí jīn gǔ
literal: Heaven · about to · bestow · great · mission · on · this · person · [particle], must · first · embitter · his · heart · will, toil · his · sinews · bones
natural: When Heaven is about to give a great task to someone, it first tests his will with suffering and wearies his body with toil

meaning.en: Hardship is a preparation for great things; quoted to encourage people through difficulty.
meaning.zh: 磨难是承担大任前的锻炼，常用来勉励人在困境中坚持。

equivalents: adversity prepares one for great tasks

examples.zh: 创业失败后，朋友用“天将降大任于是人也，必先苦其心志，劳其筋骨”安慰他。
examples.en: After his start-up failed, a friend comforted him with '天将降大任于是人也，必先苦其心志，劳其筋骨'.

examples.zh: “天将降大任于是人也，必先苦其心志，劳其筋骨”，这段日子就当是历练。
examples.en: '天将降大任于是人也，必先苦其心志，劳其筋骨': take these days as training.

story.en: A passage from 'Gaozi II' citing Shun, Fu Yue, Guan Zhong and others who rose from hardship to greatness.
story.zh: 孟子《告子下》列举舜、傅说、管仲等人由困苦中崛起的例子。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 合抱之木，生于毫末；九层之台，起于累土
pinyin: hé bào zhī mù, shēng yú háo mò, jiǔ céng zhī tái, qǐ yú lěi tǔ
literal: two-arms-encircling · [of] · tree, grows · from · fine · tip; nine · storey · [of] · tower, rises · from · piled · earth
natural: A tree that takes two arms to embrace grows from a tiny sprout; a nine-storey tower rises from a heap of earth

meaning.en: Great things grow from small beginnings; quoted to encourage patient, steady accumulation.
meaning.zh: 大事业都从微小处开始，常用来鼓励循序渐进、积少成多。

equivalents: great oaks from little acorns grow

examples.zh: “合抱之木，生于毫末；九层之台，起于累土”，学语言要从每天背十个单词开始。
examples.en: '合抱之木，生于毫末；九层之台，起于累土': learning a language starts with ten words a day.

examples.zh: 老板用“合抱之木，生于毫末；九层之台，起于累土”勉励新员工。
examples.en: The boss used '合抱之木，生于毫末；九层之台，起于累土' to encourage the new staff.

story.en: Laozi, chapter 64, followed by 'a journey of a thousand li begins with a single step' (千里之行，始于足下).
story.zh: 《老子》第六十四章，下文即“千里之行，始于足下”。

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前6—前4世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 6th–4th c. BC

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 祸兮福之所倚，福兮祸之所伏
pinyin: huò xī fú zhī suǒ yǐ, fú xī huò zhī suǒ fú
variants: 祸兮福所倚，福兮祸所伏
literal: misfortune · [particle] · fortune · [of] · what leans on, fortune · [particle] · misfortune · [of] · what lies hidden in
natural: Misfortune is what good fortune leans on; fortune is where misfortune lies hidden

meaning.en: Good and bad luck transform into each other; quoted to console people in setbacks and to warn against complacency.
meaning.zh: 祸福相互依存、相互转化，常用来安慰失意者，也提醒得意者不可骄傲。

equivalents: every cloud has a silver lining

examples.zh: 失业未必是坏事，“祸兮福之所倚，福兮祸之所伏”。
examples.en: Losing a job isn't necessarily bad: '祸兮福之所倚，福兮祸之所伏'.

examples.zh: 他把“祸兮福之所倚，福兮祸之所伏”当作人生信条。
examples.en: He takes '祸兮福之所倚，福兮祸之所伏' as a creed.

story.en: Laozi, chapter 58, the source of the story of the old man at the frontier (塞翁失马).
story.zh: 《老子》第五十八章，也是“塞翁失马”典故的思想来源。

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前6—前4世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 6th–4th c. BC

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 知人者智，自知者明
pinyin: zhī rén zhě zhì, zì zhī zhě míng
literal: know · others · one · wise, know · oneself · one · enlightened
natural: One who knows others is wise; one who knows himself is enlightened

meaning.en: Knowing others is cleverness, but knowing yourself is true clarity; quoted to advise honest self-awareness.
meaning.zh: 了解别人是聪明，了解自己才是真正的明白，常用于劝人自知。

examples.zh: “知人者智，自知者明”，认清自己的长短才能进步。
examples.en: '知人者智，自知者明': only by knowing your strengths and weaknesses can you improve.

examples.zh: 面试官喜欢引用“知人者智，自知者明”。
examples.en: Interviewers like to quote '知人者智，自知者明'.

story.en: Laozi, chapter 33, which continues 'one who overcomes others is strong; one who overcomes himself is mighty'.
story.zh: 《老子》第三十三章，下文为“胜人者有力，自胜者强”。

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前6—前4世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 6th–4th c. BC

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物
pinyin: dào shēng yī, yī shēng èr, èr shēng sān, sān shēng wàn wù
literal: the Way · gives birth to · one, one · gives birth to · two, two · gives birth to · three, three · gives birth to · ten-thousand · things
natural: The Way produces one, one produces two, two produce three, and three produce all things

meaning.en: Daoist cosmology of how the world unfolds from the Way; quoted when discussing origins and how things multiply.
meaning.zh: 道家宇宙生成论，说万物由“道”逐层演化，常用来谈起源和事物的衍生。

examples.zh: 哲学课上老师讲到“道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物”。
examples.en: In philosophy class the teacher spoke of '道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物'.

examples.zh: “道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物”，一个想法能衍生出一个行业。
examples.en: '道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物': one idea can grow into a whole industry.

story.en: Laozi, chapter 42; later commentators interpret the one, two and three in several ways (e.g. qi, yin-yang, and their harmony).
story.zh: 《老子》第四十二章，后世对“一、二、三”有不同解释（如气、阴阳与冲气）。

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前6—前4世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 6th–4th c. BC

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 吾生也有涯，而知也无涯
pinyin: wú shēng yě yǒu yá, ér zhī yě wú yá
literal: my · life · [particle] · has · limit, but · knowledge · [particle] · has no · limit
natural: My life has limits, but knowledge has none

meaning.en: Life is short and knowledge is boundless, so one cannot learn everything; quoted to urge efficient study or humility before learning.
meaning.zh: 人生有限而知识无限，常用来劝人珍惜时间、抓紧学习，或在学问面前保持谦虚。

equivalents: art is long, life is short

examples.zh: “吾生也有涯，而知也无涯”，所以读书要有选择。
examples.en: '吾生也有涯，而知也无涯': so reading must be selective.

examples.zh: 他以“吾生也有涯，而知也无涯”自勉，终身学习。
examples.en: He encourages himself with '吾生也有涯，而知也无涯' and learns all his life.

story.en: The opening of the Zhuangzi chapter 'The Principle of Nourishing Life', which adds that chasing the limitless with the limited is perilous.
story.zh: 《庄子·养生主》开篇，下文说“以有涯随无涯，殆已”。

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 相濡以沫，不如相忘于江湖
pinyin: xiāng rú yǐ mò, bù rú xiāng wàng yú jiāng hú
literal: mutually · moisten · with · spittle, not · as good as · mutually · forget · in · rivers · lakes
natural: Moistening each other with spit is not as good as forgetting one another in the rivers and lakes

meaning.en: Fish stranded on dry land keep each other alive with spit, but it would be better for them to be free in the water; quoted about letting go and freedom.
meaning.zh: 泉涸的鱼互相用唾沫湿润，不如在江湖中各自自在，常用于说放手与自由。

equivalents: better to part freely than to cling in hardship

examples.zh: 分手时他说：“相濡以沫，不如相忘于江湖”。
examples.en: When they split he said: '相濡以沫，不如相忘于江湖'.

examples.zh: 文章借“相濡以沫，不如相忘于江湖”劝人别困在苦难中互相拖累。
examples.en: The article used '相濡以沫，不如相忘于江湖' to urge people not to drag each other down in hardship.

story.en: A parable in 'The Great and Venerable Teacher': when springs dry up, fish on land moisten each other, yet they would be better to forget one another in rivers and lakes. Elsewhere 相濡以沫 alone praises mutual help in hardship.
story.zh: 《庄子·大宗师》寓言：泉涸，鱼相处于陆，相呴以湿，相濡以沫，不如相忘于江湖。

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 锲而舍之，朽木不折；锲而不舍，金石可镂
pinyin: qiè ér shě zhī, xiǔ mù bù zhé, qiè ér bù shě, jīn shí kě lòu
literal: carve · and · give up · it, rotten · wood · not · break; carve · and · not · give up, metal · stone · can · be engraved
natural: If you carve and then give up, even rotten wood will not break; if you carve and do not give up, even metal and stone can be engraved

meaning.en: Perseverance achieves what talent alone cannot; the source of 锲而不舍, quoted to urge persistence.
meaning.zh: 坚持不懈就能成事，是“锲而不舍”的出处，常用来勉励人持之以恒。

equivalents: slow and steady wins the race

examples.zh: “锲而舍之，朽木不折；锲而不舍，金石可镂”，只要坚持，就没有攻不克的难题。
examples.en: '锲而舍之，朽木不折；锲而不舍，金石可镂': with persistence no problem is unsolvable.

examples.zh: 导师送给毕业生的话是“锲而舍之，朽木不折；锲而不舍，金石可镂”。
examples.en: The mentor's parting words to the graduates were '锲而舍之，朽木不折；锲而不舍，金石可镂'.

story.en: From Xunzi's essay 'An Exhortation to Learning', stressing that consistent effort matters more than natural ability.
story.zh: 出自荀子《劝学》，强调持之以恒胜于天资。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。
